成员在外网，又没有自己的服务器时用。用你的巡瞳 AI 账号（设置里的 API K: For members on the internet when you don't have your own server. Connects to Xuntong's relay server with your Xuntong AI account (the API Key in Settings).
成员的画面叠加带他名字的水印（防截图外传，适合外包）: Overlay a watermark with the member's name on their screen (deters leaked screenshots; good for outsourcing)
打开后，你巡瞳账号里的识别（抓拍助手、告警推送、大模型识别接口）都会只按这个项目: Once enabled, all recognition in your Xuntong account (snapshot assistant, alert push, LLM recognition API) will only detect this project's classes and stop reporting other hazards. 把数据、训练过程、评估、推荐阈值、误报测试整理成一份报告，交给客户验收: Compile data, training process, evaluation, recommended threshold and false-positive tests into a report for client acceptance
把类别和规则存到巡瞳平台上（默认不启用，不影响平台现在的识别）。绑定后每次保存规: Stores classes and rules on the Xuntong platform (disabled by default, so current platform recognition is unaffected). 按安装程序的提示完成安装，项目和数据都会保留。: Follow the installer to finish. Your projects and data will be kept.

检查标注里的常见问题，找出漏标、错标、重复图片等，点一下就能去改。: Checks annotations for common problems such as unlabeled objects, wrong labels and duplicate images. Click one to fix it.

Detection, segmentation and keypoint projects can be converted into a multi-label project in one click on the Data page.

评估错例和体检跳到标注页后，只在这批图里翻；图上直接标出漏检、误报、标错类别的具: When you open evaluation errors or health-check issues on the Annotate page, you now page through just that batch, and the exact missed, extra and wrong-class boxes are drawn on the image.
训练前提醒标得太少的类别，以及预标注没人改过的图，可以一键去看这批。: Before training, you're warned about classes with too few annotations and about images whose pre-labels nobody edited, with a one-click way to review them.
教程新增「怎么选任务类型」，按常见场景说明该用检测、分割、分类还是多标签。: The tutorial has a new "Choosing a task type" section explaining, scenario by scenario, when to use detection, segmentation, classification or multi-label.

Detection, segmentation, keypoint and classification models are supported; the task must match the project.

The first time, the component is installed and pretrained weights are downloaded automatically.

Mosaic 拼图、随机缩放平移、颜色抖动、水平翻转等按 Ultralytics: Mosaic, random scale and translation, color jitter, horizontal flip and more are on by Ultralytics defaults. To change them, write them in "More parameters" below, e.g. mosaic=0.5, fliplr=0.
一行一个 key=value，原样交给 Ultralytics 训练，比如 co: One key=value per line, passed to Ultralytics training as is, e.g. cos_lr=True, patience=30, optimizer=AdamW. Data and output locations are managed by the app; setting them here has no effect.
导入别处训好的 YOLO 等 ONNX 模型，用来预标注、评估和部署: Import an ONNX model (YOLO, etc.) trained elsewhere for pre-labeling, evaluation and deployment
Ultralytics 认得的模型名都可以：官方权重会自动下载（如 yolo11: Any model name Ultralytics knows works: official weights are downloaded automatically (e.g. yolo11x-seg.pt, yolo12m.pt, rtdetr-l.pt), and structure files train from scratch (e.g. yolo11s.yaml). Names with -seg, -pose or -cls are segmentation, keypoint and classification models.

训练支持 Ultralytics 模型：模型下拉框里可以直接选 YOLO11、Y: Train Ultralytics models: pick YOLO11, YOLO26, YOLOv8, YOLO12, YOLOv10, YOLOv9 or RT-DETR right in the model list, for detection, segmentation, keypoints and classification. You can also enter any model name, continue from a local .pt or train from a .yaml. The component and weights are installed and downloaded automatically the first time.
Ultralytics 模型训完自动转成 ONNX，用 Wulabel 自己的评: Ultralytics models are converted to ONNX after training and evaluated with Wulabel's own metrics and error browser; pre-labeling, live test, batch recognition, export and inference service packages work right away. "More parameters" in advanced settings accepts any training argument.
分割项目默认推荐 YOLO11 分割，比 Mask R-CNN 快、准。: Segmentation projects now default to YOLO11 segmentation, which is faster and more accurate than Mask R-CNN.
导入的外部模型支持分割、关键点、分类项目，也能实时验证、导出和生成推理服务包。: Imported external models now work in segmentation, keypoint and classification projects, and can be used for live tests, export and inference service packages.
